The State Emergency Service advises that people should:
* Don't drive, ride or walk through flood water.
* Keep clear of creeks and storm drains.
* Stay indoors, away from windows, while storms are nearby.

warning-info.text: The next warning is due to be issued by 10:50 pm.

text.p: Check https://www.bom.gov.au/weather-and-climate/warnings-and-alerts. Warnings are also available through TV and Radio broadcasts or call 1300 659 210. The Bureau and State Emergency Service would appreciate warnings being broadcast regularly.

forecast-period.text: Isolated heavy rainfall about the Lower South East.

text.p: Weather Situation: A moist and unstable airmass combines with a trough to produce slow-moving showers with heavy rainfall about the Lower South East this evening.
Severe showers are likely to produce heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding in the warning area over the next several hours.
